methods.name: fit
methods.summary: Estimate a trend component, multiple seasonal components, and a

parameters.description: Data to be decomposed. Must be squeezable to 1-d.
parameters.name: endog

parameters.description:
Periodicity of the seasonal components. If None and endog is a pandas
Series or DataFrame, attempts to determine from endog. If endog is a
ndarray, periods must be provided.
parameters.name: periods
parameters.type_doc: int, sequence of int, or None, optional

parameters.description:
Length of the seasonal smoothers for each corresponding period.
Must be an odd integer, and should normally be >= 7 (default). If None
then default values determined using 7 + 4 * np.arange(1, n + 1, 1)
where n is number of seasonal components.
parameters.name: windows
parameters.type_doc: int, sequence of int, or None, optional

parameters.description:
The lambda parameter for the Box-Cox transform to be applied to `endog`
prior to decomposition. If None, no transform is applied. If "auto", a
value will be estimated that maximizes the log-likelihood function.
parameters.name: lmbda

parameters.description: Number of iterations to use to refine the seasonal component.
parameters.name: iterate

signature: MSTL(endog: 'ArrayLike1D', *, periods: 'int | Sequence[int] | None' = None, windows: 'int | Sequence[int] | None' = None, lmbda: 'float | str | None' = None, iterate: 'int' = 2, stl_kwargs: 'dict[str, int | bool | None] | None' = None)
summary: Season-Trend decomposition using LOESS for multiple seasonalities
